title: PvP textures
description: this texture pack includes better tools for pvp that are cleaner and smoother for pvp. try this out if you love 1.8 or other pvp modes.
body: This texture pack is great for people who love pvp! this texture pack includes many cool new textures. there are new textures for the pickaxes, axes , swords and the totem of undying. I hope you like it (:
